Genesis account-layer infrastructure exposed through 420 Wallet and reusable by all dApps.

Genesis interoperability standard and registry layer. Defines reusable versioned interfaces for canonical identity, entitlements, capability checks, payment references, encryption endpoints, sessions, checkpoints and privacy proofs; registers provider-neutral adapters and namespaces; preserves append-only external-ID mappings and hash-chained checkpoints. External systems may map into native 420 Integrated state but cannot silently overwrite canonical identity, rights, provenance, custody, governance or settlement truth.
indexer/UI; reads chain and protocol registries
contract-free discovery/indexing layer over canonical chain and protocol-owned state; ranking, indexes, caches and APIs are replaceable and non-authoritative

Genesis encrypted wallet-to-wallet messaging coordination layer. Wallets publish rotatable public key-package and transport commitments, conversations require explicit peer consent, either side may block or close, and optional on-chain envelope commitments are replay-safe and strictly sequenced. Plaintext, ciphertext blobs, attachments, media, private keys and decryption keys remain off-chain/end-to-end encrypted; 420ResourceProtocol may provide transport/storage without becoming content authority. 420Commons remains the community-space/channel layer.

Genesis budget and public-funds control plane over 420Vault VAULT_TREASURY custody. Civic/GovernanceTimelock creates bounded budgets and schedules exact disbursements; a one-time bound disbursement controller atomically reserves/settles budget accounting; execution remains default-deny and capability-scoped to the exact disbursement, with single/epoch asset caps, replay-safe canonical IDs, time windows and nonzero Vault release commitments. 420Treasury has no independent custody path or unrestricted executive key.

Genesis non-custodial grants lifecycle over 420Civic, 420Treasury and 420Vault. Programs bind to approved Treasury budgets and Civic action commitments; applications are canonical and immutable; awards and milestones are capped; claims are applicant/capability scoped; milestone approval requires an exact matching scheduled Treasury disbursement and payment finality follows Treasury execution. Grants cannot custody funds, bypass Treasury controls, or claw back paid funds without a separately authorized recovery action.

Genesis non-custodial project-launch and token-sale coordination layer. Projects bind an externally supplied sale asset and immutable issuance commitment; sales fix payment asset, receiver, soft/hard caps, per-wallet limits, token allocation, timing, eligibility policy and optional liquidity commitment. Contributions, claims and refunds are CapabilityRegistry-scoped and default-deny. Launchpad records payment, delivery and refund commitments but does not mint arbitrary tokens, custody proceeds, execute payments or gain unilateral 420Swap authority.

shared decentralized resource-network substrate. Providers activate against staking references and publish service-specific nodes/offers; consumers open bounded native-420 sessions with replay-safe metering. Encrypted routes, stored payloads, cached content and gateway traffic remain off-chain. This replaces the previously mapped incomplete 420 VPN placeholder lifecycle; existing VPN contracts remain legacy compatibility source, while 420Relay is the canonical routing product.

Genesis opt-in attention economy. Sponsors create campaigns with immutable metadata, audience-policy, verifier, budget, reward-rate and per-account cap commitments; declared budgets are segregated as sponsor liabilities in AttentionTreasury before activation. Participants explicitly opt in, campaign-bound verifiers commit replay-safe attention proofs without publishing raw behavioral telemetry, each proof can accrue at most one capped reward, and participants claim native 420 from pre-reserved campaign funds. Generic governance treasury transfers cannot spend sponsor campaign liabilities; unused balances are refundable only after campaign closure and resolution of reserved rewards. Advertisers/verifiers gain no wallet-key, custody, governance, bridge, validator or unrestricted smart-account authority.
